display_title: Smash it Wild: Tactical Volleyball Roguelike

reviews.text: First things first: This is by no means a bad game. If you enjoyed the demo, you’ll very likely enjoy the full version as well. I played the demo and was genuinely excited for “more” – but that’s exactly where I felt a bit let down. From what I’ve experienced, the full game doesn’t offer that much new beyond additional teams and higher difficulties. If you played the demo, you’ve basically seen the core of what the game has to offer. The gameplay itself is really enjoyable and the concept is fantastic, but I’m not convinced that a roguelike structure was the best choice for it. Characters like the Heavy feel almost useless without specific movement upgrades, and overall I had way too limited resources during my runs with very little meaningful control over how to spend them. I beat the Bronze Run in the demo and the Silver Run in the full game, and honestly… I expected more. Longer runs, more over-the-top skills to experiment with, bigger synergies – something that feels truly rewarding. Instead, just when you finally assemble some decent items and abilities, the run is already over. The roguelike elements don’t add much depth either. Starting each run with more resources is nice but way too expensive to actually buy. Many unlocks feel either redundant or so mandatory that they should have been available from the start. Even a successful run only gives you slightly above 50 points – and that says a lot when there are already so few upgrades to choose from in the first place. Most of them are either redundant or feel mandatory. Things like more Gold, more Coaches, or more Relics should honestly come for free after every run as basic motivation and progression, not locked behind a tiny point reward. Maybe I haven’t seen every little thing yet, but after my playtime it genuinely feels like I’ve experienced everything significant the game has to offer — aside from the usual incremental upgrades that mostly just extend your playtime artificially. All that said, the game is solid and I think 10€ is a fair price. It just could have been fleshed out more in terms of variety, depth and run length. I’ll probably check back in the future if they add substantial new content, but for now I feel like I’ve seen what there is to see.

Great looking game with a great concept! Unfortunately it is full of issues. Let's start with the worst. The game's code got issues, as there are instances wherein Rows and Collumns are confused, and instances where Money and Inspiration are confused, and even where Rounds and Games are confused. The tile effects overlap but there are no proper indicators, meaning there can be effects on tiles you wouldn't know about due to another effect being on top of it (I lost a run due to that). Now for the less bad stuff. The game is pretty short and shallow, with only 4 teams, and I believe only 2 female characters? Could use some added content. The game is never very clear with its wording and explanations, and the ui doesn't show you as much as you'd prefer. For example, one important thing the game never tells you is that you cannot move through a teammate. Also tied to that, text of skills and gears and attacks and their upgrades don't explain properly how they work and how they change. Sometimes it's simple enough, but other times a skill upgrade will just hit you with a "(1 -> 2)" without explaining how the effect changes, and you have to guess on its mechanics. The run loop is rather inconsistent and its balance is off. I understand it's a roguelike and it's meant to be more random and chaotic, but I know roguelikes that at least give you the option of a choice with guaranteed healing before a final boss. All of this isn't very good for a strategy roguelike. In conclusion, the game has PLENTY of potential, and I love the animal sports anime idea, but as it is right now, it's pretty apparent is't pretty incomplete, from the lack of content to it's very clear issues in how it's format is designed that negatively affects clarity for the player and outright code blunders, this game isn't up to quality right now, I believe. Hopefully that changes and this review becomes obsolete, that'd be most awesome and I'd be so happy! But as it is right now, I can't entirely recommend it, unless you really just wanna try it out and are curious and don't mind the price. It will give you some hours of good fun as it has given me.

I enjoyed it enough to get all the achievements in about 12 hours of play, but I am not so sure I would recommend it to everyone. There really isn't much to the game and I ran into numerous bugs, like optional challenges not going through even though I did them, soooo many typos, and very unclear language in what the moves do. Every run with each team also feels largely the same. A lot of the moves between teams are really basic and have a lot of overlap between them. Difficulty: very easy, especially comparing to many other roguelites. I lost maybe... 2 matches?

The gameplay is really good, and is really engaging. I wish I could spend way more time in this game, but this is exactly the reason why I'm leaving a negative review. The game simply does not have enough content for you to enjoy. You get 4 teams, each team has 3 diffculty levels for you to beat, thus you get 12 runs to complete. Personally that took me 11 hours, and that's it, no point for me to play anymore. I expected way more, especially since, when compared to the demo, the game didn't add a ton of content, yes new features were added, but I would happily let go of coaches if that meant I get a gamemode which lets me play longer. For 10$ this can be a good deal for you, but personally I feel let down. I will once again stress the fact that the gameplay is simply amazing, ever since the first demo, I waited with excitement for the full relaese, but unfortunately the lack of content leaves me with a sense of dissapointment. A new game mode which could perhaps let me play infintely, to see how far I can get with a certain team would be nice? Perhaps a gamemode with longer runs? I don't really care, I'll gladly take anything, and will happily turn this review positive if more content comes.

[h3]这就是功夫排球[/h3] 在遥远的二十年前，全明星阵容的电视剧《功夫足球》给我打开了新世界的大门，原来足球还能这么踢；而到了今天，《动物排球社》则是告诉了我排球还能酱紫打，我愿称之为“功夫排球”。 不过说到底这也是经典的类肉鸽回合制玩法，咱们得带上已经搭配好的3人队伍开始旅程。游戏内包含寒境战团、伊利西安、萨满战团以及光耀战团4个不同的队伍，初始我们只能使用寒境战团。 我们要在看似是3*5实际是2*3的场地内和对手竞争，双方都可以在6格的场地中对任意一格进行击打，一旦对方无人接球就算是胜利。比赛是三局两胜制的，在每一局之间都有充分的时间可以挑战站位，准备战术制定策略。 每一个角色的属性都包括了体力、力量和防御，体力除了接球时会消耗，每移动一格还会额外消耗1点，力量和防御则是会决定攻击和接球的伤害量，这几种属性都可以通过游戏内的事件进行提升。此外还有一种固定的属性——移动，每个球员的移动数值都不相同，而他们只能在移动范围内进行接球。 想要让对手无法接球主要得通过两种方式，第一种是力大砖飞，通过不断使用技能直接把对手的体力值消耗一空，让他们无法移动。第二种则是通过击打的位置选择，将敌人引导到下一回合无法接球的地方，就可以不战而屈人之兵，轻松的获得胜利。 游戏内是以时间进行推进的，我们每天可以选择不同的事件来获取收益，包括装备、技能、属性什么的，都可以在事件里获取。技能也可以通过比赛胜利后的幸福三选一获得一个，实际上除了比赛之外，其他的全部事件都不怎么耗费事件，整体节奏是很快的。 在每一局独立的游戏完成过后，还会获得一定数量的荣誉值，可以用来在主页面升级天赋，获得不错的局外加成。 总体而言，本作的玩法确实很有意思，而且排球的题材也比较少见。游戏整体节奏把控的不错，单局时长也就半小时左右，不过受限于内容量比较少，每个队伍玩上几次过后就没有太多新鲜感了，在前几个小时里能带来非常不错的体验。 [quote]关注鉴赏组：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45134494]浮生评测[/url] ←"浮生若梦，一鉴倾心，邀您共赏人间烟火" 加入Steam组：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/LLFLLFF]浮生评测[/url]←“一起追寻'浮生若梦'般的游戏体验” 开始“浮生若梦”鉴赏组的奇幻之旅！[/quote]

Cool idea for the roguelike genre. VERY easy to get the hang of and find out consistent strategies that will win. I lost probably a total of 3 games over my playtime. 100%ed the game in about 4 hours but it was a fun 4 hours. If you're looking for a game to enjoy and beat on a day off, this would be a nice pick up. Wish there was a bit more depth to have me coming back, but for the sale price I'd say I got my money's worth. It's not redefining the genre, just a neat take on it

I feel like this game could have great potential, it has a decent price for where its at right now but I feel the tutorial needs changed, it took me forever to realize what feint did and I'm not even sure I do fully know what it does, its hard to make builds for specific characters and there are a couple of bugs here and there, but I feel once it's updated and some new stuff is added, it could be a really great game to play.

it's good! quite fun. the art is appealing and the gameplay is quite interesting. there's some fun ways to outsmart opponents and end games early by getting a touchdown, but there's also the option to brute force your way through your opponents health bars and get a touchdown that way. a unique concept in general too which i appreciate. can confidently say it's the first tactical volleyball game i've ever played. my one gripe so far is that going from the easy tournament to the medium difficulty tournament is quite a big jump. it doesn't help that there's some parts that aren't super well explained in the tutorial. there's a rulebook too, but it answers the questions in a pretty basic way, leaving a lot up to interpretation. a common experience i'm finding myself in as i play the game is thinking. 'alright, all set, i'll be fine on the next turn' - only to be blindsided by an attack i didn't understand well enough after reading it in the enemy team's attack list. or to find out that characters no longer regenerate stamina to full after a match on the higher difficulty. Since this is a relatively new game, there's not much info online, and i find myself trying to look stuff up, both online and in the game's manual, only to not find anything and get a bit frustrated. i'm confident i'll get over it though, and eventually learn the mechanics proper by just playing. and i'd rather have it be a little too hard than be a little to easy, at least personally.

《动物排球社》将排球题材做成了回合制策略玩法，不得不说很有新意。具体来说就是将躲避球和排球规则进行了结合，但即使是完全没有接触过排球的玩家，在上手玩上一局之后也能很快理解机制并上手。 简单来说，我们就是要想办法先通过造成对面球员之间或者球员和场地边缘之间的碰撞来消耗他们的体力值，当体力值归零，就没办法移动接球了，这时候我们把球打到他们接不到的格子，就得分了。 看起来挺简单，但实际上门道很多。球员的攻击技能、被动技能、装备、宝物等，想要形成配合还是很有讲究的。前两个难度的联赛很简单，第三个难度开始就给玩家上强度了，最后一场的敌人不仅数值高，技能也比较赖皮，所以反复游戏来获得场外资源，解锁更高级的技能或者开启更高级的功能比如助教（其实就是相当于多了一些全局BUFF）就非常必要了。这个过程中是有一些肉鸽要素的，运气和搭配策略都很重要。 总的来说，《动物排球社》是一个很有创意的游戏，玩起来易上手，但想通关第三难度的联赛就不简单了，反复游戏来解锁高级内容是必然需要的。对于喜欢回合制游戏的玩家来说，这个游戏玩法新颖且几乎找不到代餐，就这一点来说就很值得一玩了。 [quote] 我的游戏真的有那么好玩吗? 关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34823631/]“我的游戏不可能那么好玩！”鉴赏家[/url],这是你从未体验过的船新版本~ [/quote]

[h2]前言：排球题材的回合制策略肉鸽 [/h2] 《动物排球社》是一款回合制肉鸽策略游戏。玩家控制一支由三只动物组成的排球队，在棋盘场地上与对手轮流进攻。 获胜条件很简单：让排球击中任意一格空地、让对手接不住即可得分，三局两胜。当然，实际对局，由于双方球员的移动范围都能覆盖大半场地，初始就想“打空位”得分自然是不可能的，真正有效的手段还是先将部分对手的体力耗尽，最终创造一个防守漏洞。 [h2] 玩法：消耗对手体力、创造防守漏洞 [/h2] 整体5×3的棋盘场地，但有效攻击区域仅限于中心2×3区域 。玩家每回合根据行动条依次指挥三名球员行动，执行移动、接球防御、扣球进攻。而无论是自主行动还是被动接球，角色在场内每移动一格都会消耗1点体力，接球时也要根据对手力量来扣减等量体力。 当体力耗尽后，虽然球员仍可在原地接球或扣球攻击，但却无法继续移动，并会像障碍物一样阻挡其他球员的路线，从而导致团队能够照顾到的场地面积大大削减。 大致来说，游戏的玩法就是依靠各个战队的特性、技能体系，或“佯攻”诱引敌人走位、或击退迫使敌人相互碰撞、或debuff不断叠加，不断削减对手体力、保留己方实力、确保自身防御不出差错的情况下，制造对手的防守漏洞。 [h2] 体验：玩法新颖、体量太小[/h2] 整体游戏玩法新颖、决策体验新鲜、美术精致出色；流程之中，也通过肉鸽元素，在各个比赛前的准备时间中进行各种随机事件的强化养成，什么装备抽奖、被动技能学习、粉丝赠礼、新增主动技能等等，为队伍提供不同的发展，带来每局游戏的随机性差异。还具备一定的局外养成系统，解锁新的装备/圣物/机制/加成。 但坦白来说，整体游戏的体量太小了。 虽然游戏提供了三重难度+四个队伍：寒境战团、伊利西安、萨满战团、光耀战团。每支队伍都有足够差异的技能体系，有的主打冰块地形与击退、某些特殊攻击可以“击碎冰块来连击”定下胜局，有的能够嘲讽并叠加瞄准标记，有的放置图腾和灵体提供增益减益，有的积累太阳能量来强化技能、在场外创造“得分区”出奇制胜。但基础打法、战术其实都相似。 大致来说，面对高难度的数值压力、轮次间回血不足，基本也是靠着“吸血鬼手套”啥的让队员反复仰卧起坐、不断苟命，算是换皮不换骨。只能说各个队伍间有一定的差异解题思路，但仍是重复感居多。 基本6-7个小时、四个队伍都打通最高难度、或者游戏全成就获取之后，新鲜感与持续游玩的动力就已然褪去大半。 [h2]总结[/h2] 总之，本作游戏体量上稍显不足，不能指望耗上了几十小时的空闲时间，但相比一众其他肉鸽作品，玩法差异度还是十分鲜明的，算是值得一试的创意佳作！ 喜欢回合制策略玩法的玩家可以试试~ [quote]加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GHYX]干货游戏[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35106417/]咱的鉴赏家[/url]，不定期为大家带来游戏体验分享，也期待您来一起分享自己的游戏体验干货~[/quote]

Creative take on tactics-style gameplay with a fun theming and art style. It focuses a lot on positioning over combat, though does often regress to simply knocking the opponents to 0 due to the later difficulty enemies having extra movement. Overall, I think a lot of the roguelike elements and player stats could be tuned differently, but still very enjoyable if you like a more puzzle-based tactics game.

Game is good, worth buying at full price imo, even if you probably won't get a ton of hours out of it atm. Things I'd like to see added: Reworked difficulties. I would difficulty rating to scale higher, be slightly more gradual, and have slightly more interesting scaling than "enemies have more stats" (imo just giving enemies more passives + items + attacks would do a ton) Multiplayer. Even if it's just local multiplayer as an option, I would love to play this vs friends. I don't think this game could sustain an active ladder population, but some level of online multiplayer would be really cool imo. Team building options. It super bugs me that there are enemy teams that are full medium, but we always have to play light + med + heavy. Being able to mix and match different weight classes and even maybe different faction mechanics to have a team-building aspect to the game would be really really cool. That said even if nothing gets added this game is solid.

I adore this game. I've always been a huge volleyball fan and seeing a game that uses its themes really well made me happy. I've already gotten all the achievements, which is so fun to do. The only hiccup I ran into was that it would crash every so often and full restart my PC. I don't know why my computer disagrees with this game, but I've had a lot of fun with it already.
真的很好玩，就是内容不够多，希望有dlc

I like this game. It is short though. I have 11 hours and have beaten it, all twelve trophies. I have two achievements left that I may go back and finish. Some of the descriptions need updating to be more clear. **I would like an option to set seed for a run, so my friend and I could race each other. That would be cool. ** It's a fun little game to my mind. Stamina recovery is pretty much the best thing you can get. The relic Sadism is absurd. Good luck out there. Oh, I'm not sure why, but the turtle flips in the victory screen. Which eye does he have a scar on? Yeah, fix that silliness, please.

《动物排球社》是一款将排球竞技与回合制策略完美融合的肉鸽游戏，游戏把赛场分为 2×3 战术棋盘，在游戏中玩家需要操控 3 名动物球员，通过移动、击球、技能与站位布局赢下比赛。 游戏核心玩法兼具策略性与趣味性。玩家可选择寒境、伊利西安、萨满、光耀四大战队，每队都拥有专属技能与战术体系，冰面控制、泥坑破防、图腾强化、太阳能量增幅等特性差异明显。角色拥有体力、力量、防御、移动等属性，击球可消耗敌方体力，使其无法移动；也可通过位置引导制造防守盲区，实现战术得分。 流程采用赛事循环模式，训练赛、事件强化、正式赛交替推进，胜利后可以三选一解锁技能，此外荣誉值也可以解锁局外天赋，并且通过装备与遗物进一步强化流派。 尽管目前内容量偏少、新手引导略有不足，但创意与玩法足够亮眼，非常适合喜欢轻量肉鸽与战术博弈的玩家。 [quote]关注「[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45580968] 月の赏 [/url]」[/quote] [u][b] 月揽千游，一赏知味 [/b][/u]

This is a very fun game, but I can't really recommend it right now because its laughably empty of content for a roguelike. the runs also lack variety most of the time, even with all additionnal skill, items and passive unlocked you end playing the same thing every run depending on the team you picked. the runs feel too short, by the time the enemy teams actually get challenging the run is over, and once you understand the mechanics of the game the only match worth playing is the finals. The scaling of difficulty is very bad, you get one passive every end of match round + the events/shops while the ai gets nothing, which means that by match 2 you are so much stronger than the ai there is simply no challenge. the stamina mechanic is also kinda there for no reason, since the runs are so short you never have to play around it This game does have very good potential, it just need more on pretty much every front. longer, MUCH harder runs would be a good start.

The concept is great but the content is incredibly small imo. The Team you can play in the demo is by far the most fun so there is no reason to switch to the others. The runs are always the same, where you focus your build on 1 of 2 team effects. Gloves and other unlocks have incredibly streamlined and boring affixes, so nothing spicy happens during runs. This is not even early access but a full release. If you need a distraction for 2-3 hours, then get this on a sale. Dont expect a lot more time out of the game, though.

Really fun; doesn't overstay its welcome. Drenched in personality. Pick between 4 pre-made teams of 3. Do roguelite encounters and events and spread various types of upgrades across your three players. Win the final match. Practice matches (basic encounters) are one round, real matches (elite encounters) are best 2/3. You get a free upgrade for each round regardless of win or loss. Pros: - really fresh and innovative concept done well. - lots of different avenues for in-run progression - getting an upgrade on round loss is a grade catchup mechanic for runs that are struggling. It can create a risk-reward situation for skilled players. - unique and exciting character design. Mixed: - Pretty overwhelming to get into, especially when trying a new team for the first time. The game works much better when you just learn by playing. - Not a _ton_ of content overall. There are only 3 difficulty levels. by the time you've gotten a decent grasp on the fundamentals of the game and made some progress on meta-progression, the hardest difficulty isn't much of a challenge. They could have added a lot more avenues of meta progression, heavily inflated meta progression costs, or just put real big numbers on another difficulty level, and I'm mostly glad they didn't. I don't really have cons. More "it would be cool if" It'd Be Cool If: - matches and rounds had the ability for an instant replay. Due to tactical gameplay and all the ui stuff to make it work, the pacing of the match on screen is pretty slow. Using an event log to reenact a round in real time would be a neat way to showcase all the neat animations and reward stylish play. Could be great clip fodder for streamers and other content creators to get the word out about this game. - Greater team flexibility. each playable team has a locked starting composition of 1 light athlete, 1 medium athlete, 1 heavy athlete. Each playable team also has unique mechanics that depend on multiple athletes sharing those mechanics, so mixing and matching athletes from different teams wouldn't really work. But by the time players have beaten the current highest difficulty I think we would be ready to have an expanded roster of playable athletes per team. Verdict: Smash it Wild is a game that is worth every second played. In its current state it's a bit short lived, but that's okay. a $12 game doesn't need to always have the promise of thousands of hours of skinner box grinding dressed up as "content." It's a great pick for anyone that has an extensive library and is looking for a good use of their *time*.

排球题材的回合制肉鸽策略游戏。将排球、回合制跟肉鸽养成等元素揉在了一起，风格挺少见的，初见体验下来感觉蛮新鲜的。玩家将选择并培养一支由三位可爱福瑞组成的队伍去打排球对抗比赛，虽然基础规则参考了排球，但底层玩起来更像在解一盘动态棋局，需要算位置、算移动，算攻击，整体带一点点小烧脑，但不会复杂到把人劝退。 把球顺利砸进对方场内且无人接球就能得分，拿到两分就算赢。开局后行动顺序会固定，敌我角色轮流行动，轮到玩家时，需选角色、选落点、决定怎么打；轮到对方，就看对方怎么选角色、怎么防。每个角色都有体力、移动、攻击、防御四个基础属性，其中体力相当于血量，由于归零会无法行动，所以“如何封锁对方行动，使其无法接球”就成了对局里非常关键的因素。 肉鸽部分比较常规，按天数推进，每天可以在训练、商店、随机事件、粉丝馈赠中进行各种奖励三选一，解锁新技能、强化角色属性、获取专属特质等。到固定天数就会打正式比赛，游玩节奏比较舒服。游戏里一共有四支小队，每队三人，风格和机制差别不小，有主打击退的冰块流，有主打伤害叠加的标记流，有主打提供增减益的图腾流，还有强化技能的能量流。 整体上手门槛不高，熟悉规则后玩起来会比较顺，难度适中。不过内容体量不算大，敌人种类不多，角色主动、被动技能数量有限，每人只能带一件装备，装备池也不算深，各种组合的随机性会弱一些，玩久了会慢慢摸到固定套路，新鲜感会下降。 总的来说，《动物排球社》跳出了传统球类游戏的思路，把竞技拆成棋盘式回合对抗，节奏轻松、动脑不累、画风可爱，偶尔玩一两局挺解压的。玩法有新意，不过体量偏轻，后期重复感会比较明显。如果能加上多人对战，想必会更耐玩一些。 [quote] 加入[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/ADZZW]爱の榨汁屋[/url]&关注[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/34815366/]爱の鉴赏家[/url]，用爱品鉴世间作品，用心流淌真情实感。 [/quote]
不能说不好玩，但是内容太少了，很容易玩腻，但你如果是独立游戏爱好者，喜欢尝尝鲜，我还是蛮建议的。

I have mixed feelings, because I love this game and it's concept. But like every review, both positive and negative, there is just not enough content to stay engaged for more than 10ish hours maximum. And even after just 90 mins of playtime, I feel like I have a very good handle on everything this game has to offer outside of winning on some of the harder difficulties. My main worry and the reason I'm getting a refund is that I'm not confident that any additional content is coming. It's concerning to see dev responses saying that 'more content is contingent on game performance and community feedback.' Maybe if this game was still in early-access...but this is a full release. And while monthly game patches are pretty common, it's been a month since release and not even the larger bugs that have been brought up in earlier reviews have been patched yet. I'm definitely going to keep my eye on this game to see if more is coming. And I'm even willing to pay a few more bucks for the release if the replayability was there.

This is a pretty interesting spin on the roguelike formula. As someone who plays volleyball, I enjoy how the sport inspired a lot of the design. It's not perfect, but it's definitely there. This game is very short. There is not a lot of replay value either. This game would benefit a lot from more content of every type (teams, attacks, passives, items, events, etc.). However, I did enjoy my time with it.

The game is enjoyable to play and has a lot of personality. I love the concept and the mechanics of a volleyball rogue-lite. I hope the developers will add new game modes in the future to increase playtime. Create your own team, career mode, 2v2... the grid gameplay might even lend itself to chess-like puzzle games. I got all of the achievements in 6 hours, so not much else to play for right now.
